text:
Alex: Heads-up — planning onboarding for nova13b. Want a short quantization + fallback smoke plan before full calibs. Proposed sequence: baseline fp16 -> gguf-int8 (per-layer) -> fp8-hybrid -> fallback to fp16 if quality regresses > 1.2% on LM-avg. Also include KV cache and context-length perf smoke. Anyone can take lead? (scheduler target: next Tue) :calendar:

Michael: I'll own the smoke harness. Quick checklist:
1) produce 500 prompt samples (mix short/long/conversational/code)
2) run evals harness to get LM-avg + rank metrics
3) run perf bench for p95 latency at 512/2048 ctx
4) produce quality delta table. I'll push a job. :wrench:

Jana: Add these thresholds: quality regression triggers rollback if:
- LM-avg delta worse by >1.0% absolute OR
- rouge/chrF on generation tasks down by >1.5% relative.
If ambiguous, run a human spot-check on 50 samples. Also ensure safety evals don't spike. :eyes:

Saniya: For calibration dataset: sample 60% from product prompts, 20% from long-form web-text, 20% code/COT. Avoid near-duplicate training data. Use a deterministic seed for sampling so calibs are reproducible.

CalibBot: smoke-run started on nova13b @ 2415872490. Running baseline fp16 -> gguf-int8 pass.

Michael: sample command for the harness:
```
./run_evals --model nova13b/fp16 --prompts=data/nova_probes.json --metrics=lm_avg,bleu,rouge --output=results/fp16.json
./quant_tool --input=nova13b/fp16 --format=gguf --precision=int8 --calib=data/calib_traces.json --out=nova13b/gguf-int8
```

Jana: Note: gguf-int8 run should include per-layer calibration and asymmetric scales. If you see token-misalignment on code, flag it.

Saniya: Perf expectations: int8 should be ~1.8-2.5x cheaper token-cost vs fp16, fp8-hybrid maybe 2.6-3.2x but with occasional accuracy noise. We'll gather cost-per-1M tokens and p95 latency deltas.

CalibBot: smoke-run results uploaded: baseline LM-avg=0.321, gguf-int8=0.316 (delta -1.56%), fp8-hybrid=0.318 (delta -0.94%). Latency p95 (512ctx): fp16=120ms, int8=85ms, fp8=78ms. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/nova13b/smoke/2415872490/

Alex: Thanks. int8 delta >1.0% per Jana — that triggers further per-layer debug. Michael can you run per-layer sensitivity and identify hot layers? Add KV-cache smoke too (512/2048).

Michael: On it. Running per-layer ablation next. Also will run a short sample of 200 code prompts to see code degradation.

Saniya: I'll prepare the canary config: route 5% traffic to fp8-hybrid with fallback to fp16 if model.latency>500ms or quality_regression>1.2% over 1h. Will include cost cap and circuit-breaker.

Jana: Suggest adding a quick KL-check for logits distribution: compare calibrations vs baseline; if KL>0.02 treat as potential miscalib. Also add a small human diff set for code outputs.

Alex: Perfect. Plan: Michael does per-layer probes today. Saniya assembles canary config. Jana reviews thresholds. We'll reconvene tomorrow AM and decide whether to proceed to full calibration. :thumbsup:

Saniya: volunteered to run canary after Michael's probes. :raised_hands:

CalibBot: per-layer probe job queued @ 2415872525

Alex: thanks everyone. adding notes to onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/model-onboard/nova13b
